title: Pencil
look: Graphite on paper: hatched shading, a soft boiling line, on twos.

doc.essence: A sketchbook study: soft graphite edges that boil on twos, diagonal hatching for value.
doc.notIt: Not line art (the line wobbles and the value is hatched), not chalkboard (light on dark).
doc.shapes: Edges in graphite; points jitter three ways at 12 fps.
doc.colour: Greys from the palette's luminance; cheeks a touch of red pencil.
doc.motion: Time steps at 12 fps (on twos) and the line boils.
pitfalls: Hatching at small scale turns grey: keep shapes big.
